issues.where: the mountain ridges and valleys across the entire continent (also shown in set-B-02.png bottom crop)
issues.what: the arid dusty tan and rust-red rock surfaces of -a are replaced by dark olive-green terrain with stark pale-cream ridges, and the valley shadows are crushed to near-black without the soft blue orbital atmospheric veil of -a
issues.fix: warm the landmass palette back toward dusty tan and rust-brown rock, reduce the ridge-to-valley contrast, and lift the dark shadows with subtle blue atmospheric scatter

issues.where: the cyclone in the lower-right ocean (top crop, also visible in set-B-01-b.png)
issues.what: the spiral cloud bands look overly sharp, fibrous, and noisy with jagged splintered streaks along the outer left flank, and the eye is a tiny hard-edged black pinprick instead of the soft feathery clouds and wider blue eye in -a
issues.fix: soften the cyclone into cohesive, volumetric satellite-style cloud bands, remove the jagged streak artifacts on the left side, and widen and soften the eye with blue atmospheric fill

issues.where: the scattered clouds over the ocean, especially on the left and lower-left
issues.what: the ocean clouds are broken into overly sharp, high-contrast white speckles and thin streaks over a darker navy sea, losing the softer diffuse cloud veils and orbital haze of -a
issues.fix: soften the sea clouds into gentler, more diffuse wispy bands and slightly lift the dark ocean blacks to match -a

issues.where: the sun glint along the upper-right ocean edge near the upper leg and foot
issues.what: the specular sun reflection is much brighter, broader, and harsher beige-white than in -a, creating a heavy glare that washes out the upper foot and coastline
issues.fix: reduce the intensity and spread of the upper-right sun glint so it fades softly into the dark sea without washing out the upper foot

issues.where: the white pelvic salt basin and the coastal/ocean area around the legs
issues.what: the white pelvic basin is noticeably smaller and more broken up than in -a with cramped red channels, and the swirling golden-ochre currents seen in the sea below the pelvis and legs in -a are missing
issues.fix: enlarge and clean up the white pelvic basin with clearer crimson branching channels and reintroduce subtle ochre-gold sediment swirls in the bays and ocean below the legs

issues.where: the skull landform on the far left and the neck region just above it
issues.what: the eye sockets and mouth read as flat dark-blue pools without the warm ochre rim on the lower eye, and the pale wispy tendrils streaming up-right from the skull in -a are absent
issues.fix: add warmer dusty-ochre rim detail to the shadowed eye sockets and restore subtle pale wispy streams trailing up-right from the skull
